name: Zendesk Customer Service Professional Certificate
description: Six-course professional certificate from Zendesk and LinkedIn Learning covering customer service foundations, problem-solving, rapport building, de-escalation, and social media customer service. Completed all 6 courses (4h 14m) and passed the final assessment.

criteria.narrative: Completed all six courses in the Zendesk Customer Service Professional Certificate learning path on LinkedIn Learning: Customer Service Foundations, Customer Service: Problem-Solving and Troubleshooting, Building Rapport with Customers, Customer Service: Handling Abusive Customers, Creating Positive Conversations with Challenging Customers, and Serving Customers Using Social Media. Passed the final summative assessment to earn the certificate.
